team.title: The team
team.metaDescription: Meet the student volunteers who run ESN Lille: the board and the poles behind every event.
team.lead: ESN Lille is run entirely by student volunteers. Meet this year's board and the poles that make every event happen.
team.polesLead: Every event starts in a pole. Join one: no experience needed, just some time and good vibes.

coPresident.name: Co-president
coPresident.mission: Set the association's direction, represent it to universities, the city and the ESN network, and coordinate the poles.

vicePresident.name: Vice-president
vicePresident.mission: Back the co-presidents, step in for them when needed and follow the poles' projects day to day.

secretary.name: Secretary
secretary.mission: Handle the paperwork: meeting minutes, general assemblies, membership records and official filings.

treasurer.name: Treasurer
treasurer.mission: Keep the books: budget, payments and ticket income, partner contracts and grant applications.

operationsManager.name: Operations manager
operationsManager.mission: Make events run smoothly on the ground: logistics, equipment, venues and volunteer schedules.
